svg.aria-label: Analytical projections and executed reconstructions of a constructed teaching section. A, D, E and difference F express attenuation in mm⁻¹; sinogram B and unfiltered backprojection C are dimensionless. The 12- and 180-direction cases use matched geometry and filtering, without detector noise; the difference image shows finite-sampling and interpolation effects.
